name: Break and Steal an Egg
research_status: IN_PROGRESS (substantially advanced by live observation SRC-017)

description_and_purpose.text: Break eggs with a pickaxe to hatch animals, evade/outrun the zone guardian, deposit animals at your base for cash, train Speed on treadmills to pass zone gates, and fill a 13-rarity Index.

tutorial.value: Exists (Shared.TutorialConfig, ReplicatedStorage.TutorialArrowParts, BatConfig.TutorialEndDelay=20) — content NOT yet read

first_minutes_goals.value: Structural inference: Zone1 gate is only 5 SpeedPower and tier-1 pickaxe is free — the first goals are break Zone1 eggs and unlock the plot treadmill (100 cash).
first_minutes_goals.caveat: Not confirmed by playing a new account.

ui_and_hints.value: How-to list in official description; tutorial arrows; overhead GuardOverhead billboards; TreadmillOverhead GUI; rarity gradients (13 tiers) for item labels.

early_barriers.value: Pity system (330s → guaranteed Rare–Epic, zones 1–2, 3500–5000 cash) exists specifically to smooth early bad luck.

device_support.value: GamepadConfig + ResponsiveUiConfig present (multi-device UI). Console/mobile support not independently confirmed.

mapped_loop.ACTION: Swing pickaxe at an egg (EggHitRequest/EggHitLanded/EggHitConfirmed) until its HP depletes → animal hatches
mapped_loop.CHALLENGE: Zone guardian chases and flings (CatchDistance 2, OutrunSpeedFactor 0.85, FlingDistance 12→115); rivals can knock you with bats; satchel capacity limits how many you carry
mapped_loop.REWARD: Place animal at base (PlaceAnimalRemote → AnimalBankedRemote) for cash; mutation rolls multiply the value up to x25
mapped_loop.PROGRESSION: Cash → pickaxe tiers (20), plot capacity (9 levels), satchel (6 tiers), treadmill (speed); Speed → zone gates 5 → 100,000,000,000
mapped_loop.NEXT_GOAL: Next zone's pool (rarity floor rises each zone: Common → Uncommon → Rare → Epic → Legendary → Mythic → Divine → Cosmic → Secret → Divine/Celestial) plus Index completion rewards (CashMult up to 100)

B_core_loop.caveat: Remote names and configs confirm each step exists; the exact failure outcome (caught → ?) is still unverified (OBS-BSE-03).

repeated_activities.activity: Carry hatched animals within satchel capacity (1–6)

why_loop_connects_to_next_goal.statement: Cash feeds four parallel sinks; only Speed opens new zones, and each new zone raises both the rarity floor and the cash ceiling — a two-currency gate that forces an explicit investment choice.

movement_traversal.value: WalkSpeed 18 base, soft cap 100, hard max 240; speed stat = SpeedPower (step cost 1, max 1e9, overdrive at 1e16/1e19); curve exponent 1.59

combat_or_primary_interaction.value: Pickaxe vs egg HP (primary) + bats vs players (knockback 17.5→48, range 15→30, cooldown 0.6/0.7s)

egg_pet_collectible.value: 458 nests over 10 zones; 86 base pool animals + 22 event extras + 58 legacy; 13 rarities; mutations (5) and size/variant axes (Diamond/Gold)

npc_ai.value: 10 named guardians; GuardSpeed 30→70; pathfinding recovery params, wind-up, far-boost, catch growth per decade; SizeRequirement affects catch difficulty

stealing_pvp.value: Rival theft of carried/pending animals (guide + video) plus explicit combat via bats; CatchFlingRemote and DropCarriedRemote exist
stealing_pvp.note: Theft flow itself not yet witnessed live (OBS-BSE-10).

inventory_equipment.value: Satchel tiers 1–6 (Bare Hands → Titanic, capacity 1→6); pickaxe tiers 1–20; 11 trails; hotbar/backpack UI configs

upgrade_stat_progression.value: Four sinks: pickaxe (20 tiers), plot (9 levels, capacity 8→16), satchel (6), treadmill (6–9 levels, CONFLICTING tables)

zones_unlock.value: 10 zones gated by RequiredPower 5 → 1e11 + SafeZone; plot culling starts at zone 7

quests_missions_achievements.value: Index with 13 rarity tiers and claimable rewards; Roblox badges incl. 'Lucky'; polls; no quest system observed

multiplayer.value: Shared servers (5/7 observed); bats, theft, global boosts, announcements, leaderboards, friend NPC boosts

trading_economy_between_players.value: No trading observed; gifting exists only as Robux gifting (RobuxShopGiftIntent/Request)

failure_penalty.value: Guard catch → fling (FlingDistance, LaunchAngle 25, RagdollDuration 3) and guide says animal is dropped; exact loss rules NOT verified

events_limited_content.value: Hell event + Hell boss, Demon event (DemonTokens), Celestial/Angel egg sets, Lucky Egg drops, admin-abuse events, global boosts, polls

daily_offline_rewards.value: Offline rewards (60s–5h, rate 0.1, ×2) + group/like/favorite reward (+10,000 Speed) + Discord reward

gamepasses_products.value: 3 permanent Robux upgrades (×2 Cash, ×2 Swing, ×2 Growth), 6 speed packs, 5 cash packs, 6 potions, fallen egg/token packs, ~28 timer-skip products, per-tier pickaxe products. Robux prices NOT captured.

timed_systems.value: Merge machine real-time growth (10s base → 7 days max, rarity multipliers ×1→×5), potion durations 900s, pity timers

codes.value: No code-redemption remote observed in the 60+ remote inventory (AntiAfkRejoin/Settings/etc. present). Third-party claim of 'no codes' is consistent but absence not proven.

D_progression_economy.prices_captured: pickaxe 20 tiers, plot 8 costs, satchel 6, treadmill 6+9 (conflicting), zone gates 10
D_progression_economy.reward_values_captured: per-animal cash for 86 base + 22 extras + partial legacy
D_progression_economy.anomaly: Live account holds 5.4e17 cash and 8.9T speed with maxed gear but SatchelTier=1 — likely admin/test account (INFERRED, MEDIUM). Do NOT treat its numbers as typical-player economy.

conflict.resolution_needed: The guide likely counts distinct egg *types* per biome — unresolved.

player_influence.value: Three verified channels: steal carried animals (guide/video), knock players with zone bats (knockback/ragdoll), and global boosts/announcements that affect everyone.

competition_vs_cooperation.value: Competition primary (bats, theft, spawn races for Lucky Eggs). Cooperation only via friend boost / invite structure (FriendNpc, FriendBoostPercent attribute = 0 observed).

risk_strategy.value: Explicit choice: carry more animals (satchel) = more reward at risk vs. bank early; zone guards scale with depth; bats let rivals deny.

griefing_risk.value: Real: higher-tier bats (range 30, knockback 48) in deep zones + theft means veterans can prey on newer players. Mitigations observed: SafeZone, plot culling from zone 7, guard as third-party threat. Severity NOT observed.

why_play_with_friends.value: Friend NPC/boost structure exists (FriendBoostPercent, InviteFriend model) but effect NOT read.

systems_actually_present.system: Real-time merge-machine growth up to 7 days
Timed Lucky Egg drops with announcement

short_term_goals.goal: Zone1 break → deposit → unlock treadmill (100) → first upgrades

mid_long_term_goals.goal: Zone gates up to 1e11 speed, 20 pickaxes, Index completion, event collections

reward_frequency.value: Every hatch + every deposit + speed per treadmill step (1/s) — frequent by structure; actual rates NOT measured

monotony_risk.point: The core verb (swing→carry→bank) never changes across 10 zones; variation comes from events, merge machine, bats and collections rather than new verbs.

likely_frustration.point: Guard fling in deep zones (FlingDistance 115 in zone 10) after long carry runs
Zone gate curve has steep steps (x15,000 / x16,000 at zones 3→5)

sections_not_yet_checked: OBS-BSE-01..11 manual observations (fresh-account flow, exact failure outcome, shop UI)
